sources_note: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags follow the official PlayStation list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles. Guides are written in my own words; each cites the sources its facts come from.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to chase directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, then the long collectible and activity grinds — and this one arrives on its own at the end. Expect a completionist run of roughly 200 hours.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and it unlocks as part of the story. No preparation or special approach is needed — just follow the mission objectives.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks at the chapter's end. While you are in Chapter 1, remember the missable meditation: Lucia's balcony spot only exists during this chapter, so do it before the chapter closes.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete all of Chapter 2's missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end. There is nothing extra to do — keep playing the story.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3 and it unlocks. Side-character strands open up around this point in the story, so it is a good moment to start the Strangers & Freaks strands alongside the main missions.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 4's missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end. One chapter remains after this, so the endgame cleanup is close.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and one of only two golds in the list. Finish the final story mission and it unlocks. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely, and the 100% completion checklist appears under Progress, so the endgame cleanup starts here.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Breakfast Run mission when the story brings it to you. It is a mission trophy, so there is no separate requirement to prepare for.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete The Cartel Heist mission in the story. Play it as the story directs; the trophy follows the mission's completion.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Child's Play mission when it appears in the story. No side requirement — finish the mission and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Headliners mission in the story. Like the other mission trophies, it needs nothing beyond finishing that mission.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the VCIA Takedown mission when the story reaches it. Finish the mission and the trophy unlocks with it.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story. It is the last of the named mission trophies before the finale, so the story trophies are nearly done when this one pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The second gold and the hardest trophy in the list. The 100% checklist appears under Progress after you finish the story, and it asks for almost everything: most of the collectible card sets (15 of 18), 70 of the 80 challenges, and the bulk of the activities and collectibles. You do not need literally everything — for example only 15 card sets count — so follow the in-game checklist itself rather than a completionist's instinct. Track it at Touch Pad, Progress, 100% Completion.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps off ramps and bridges, flights under bridges, knife flights between Vice City towers, and base jumps from the tallest peaks and buildings. You need a little over half the total, so pick the easy ones first — stunt jumps and under-bridge flights are the most plentiful. Find discovered stunt spots at Touch Pad, Exploration, Stunt Spots, and track progress at Progress, Activities, Stunts.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, and a stunt. You only need one attempt at each, not a win, so work through the list and sample anything you have not touched yet. Most of these overlap with other trophies, so it usually pops naturally during a broad playthrough.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers to clear for gold, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Find ranges at Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way. This is one of the two trophies most guides call hardest, so leave it for a focused session with a steady aim.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some locations charge an entry fee, so bring cash. Learn each course's line before pushing for the win — a clean run beats a fast, crashing one. Locations you have found show at Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — replays of the same race do not count. Race locations appear all over Leonida as you explore; track them at Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating matters, so upgrade at Mod Shops if you bring your own ride. Spread your wins across the map rather than grinding one favourite.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2 kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area and fish there until you land one big enough — the game shows the weight, so keep casting until a catch clears 2 kg. Any boat in the area works if you do not own one yet.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish one full game on it. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to its end rather than quitting mid-game.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's story missions, ending with the final one. Andy's strand is Lucia-only and opens from Chapter 3, so play it as Lucia when the missions appear. The trophy pops when the last mission in the strand is done.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with the mission named Maritime Disputes. Work through Kenton's missions as they appear and the trophy unlocks with the final one.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with the mission named Hometown Heroes. Complete each of Billy's missions in turn and the trophy pops at the strand's end.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. A strand only counts when its final mission is done, so half-finished strands do not help. The five named side characters — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — each carry one strand, and other strangers fill the rest. Start strands as they appear during the story and finish them before moving on, so none is left half done at the end.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Randy's missions, ending with the final one. Randy's strand involves a vehicle wish list, so keep an eye out for the cars he wants as you drive around Leonida — spotting them during normal play saves backtracking later.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Tyrone's missions, ending with the final one. Tyrone's strand touches the Kitty Litter Lab locations, so note them when you pass one — they feed the strand's progress.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. THIS IS THE LIST'S ONLY MISSABLE TROPHY: one meditation, Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1, disappears after that chapter ends, so do it during Chapter 1 before the story moves on. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played, so wait it out at each spot instead of walking away early. Discovered spots show at Touch Pad, Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida; progress at Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Take a suitable weapon and track it in the area Bret points to — unique animals do not respawn on demand, so approach quietly and make the shot count.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards hide all over Leonida, and you can sell spares at pawn shops without losing progress — sold cards still count toward your sets. Track them at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Since 100% completion needs 15 sets, this trophy falls on the way to the platinum.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up to open it). Scannable spots include landmarks, curiosities and sculptures dotted around Leonida — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures are listed among them, so there are more than enough. Scan everything you pass while doing other things and the count climbs on its own. Check progress at Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are in-game feats that reward skillful play across combat, driving and exploration. You can view them all and their requirements at Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges. Pick the easy ones first — the count matters, not the difficulty — and note that 100% completion asks for 70, so this one leads into the gold.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it somewhere with good escape routes — open roads and alleys you know — and break line of sight before the search dies down. Having your partner along is part of the requirement, so do not attempt it solo.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them — the chain breaks if the heat drops. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast, and keep moving between them so the wanted level stays live. A fast car parked outside each shop helps.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting inside one or scanning it with WAiNK both count as a discovery, so this climbs naturally as you play — story missions alone put a dent in it. Check what you have found at Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles, and use WAiNK scans in traffic to pick up new models without stealing them.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a firefight with several hostiles close together — trigger Combat Focus, and chain the kills before it ends. Five in one use is the whole requirement, so a crowded fight is the place to try.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule — take a plane out without going through a normal departure. Grab an aircraft on the airfield and get airborne; the trophy pops once you are away from the airport.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is the hint: get into a Rhino tank and make it count. Tanks draw heavy police attention, so pick your moment, climb in, and cause the chaos the trophy's joke implies — survive the heat that follows.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, move when staff look away, and get out before anyone raises the alarm. One detection ruins the attempt, so a clean, patient run beats a fast one.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault needs its own getaway, so plan an escape route before you go in — a fast car stashed nearby and a route away from the response. Five clean escapes earn the silver.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks travel set routes, so watch for one, stop it, crack it open, and take the cash — then lose the wanted level that follows. A heavy vehicle to ram it with makes the stop much easier.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — the whole map, from Vice City to the swamps and the Keys. Drive, fly and sail into the corners you have never visited; the game tracks which regions you have seen. A long road trip after the story, hitting each region in turn, closes the gaps the story left.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Every gang runs its own operations around Leonida, so you need one hit per gang — nine in total, each against a different crew. Hitting a gang's operation makes that gang hostile, so space the hits out and be ready for the response.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and enjoy a cocktail there. Sit through the drink with the ocean in front of you and the trophy pops. A quiet one — no chaos required.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's front window — the classic GTA exit. Pick a showroom with a big glass front, build speed on the approach, and smash out through it. The trophy is about the exit, so the getaway after it is just for fun.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a proper game — follow through on your throw rather than rushing it. Play the alley's game as intended and the trophy follows a completed visit.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This one is about Jason and Lucia together: build the partnership up until it hits its peak. Play as both characters, keep the pair's shared activities going, and the trophy pops when the partnership reaches its best.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make the story choices the game puts in front of you — the description covers choices with consequences. There is no single right pick; play through the decision points the story offers and the trophy records that choices were made.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed on the second try. The name gives it away: this pops when a second attempt lands after a first one did not. Do not worry about failing on purpose — a natural retry during a tricky mission or activity is the usual way it happens.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Stumble into one of Leonida's strangest moments — the kind of odd, unexplained event that makes you stop and ask what just happened. Explore the map's odd corners and the trophy finds you when you meet one of the game's weird encounters.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock enemies down with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Find a slow, straight stretch with pedestrians or enemies in reach, line the pass up, and swing as you roll past. One clean hit is enough.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash over time — keep feeding bills through whenever you have them and the total adds up. Pair it with the bank vault and shop robbery trophies, which produce the bills to launder.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, anything with a price tag counts toward the same total. Find shops on the map at Touch Pad, Style. The easiest way is to fold it into normal play: buy the upgrades and outfits you want anyway and the counter climbs. If you are short at the end, car mods are the fastest way to burn the remainder.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone: Mitchel Auto Center ($4,000), 7th Avenue Garage ($12,000), Vela Rota Drive Garage ($24,000), Persistence Road Garage ($7,600), Wyatt Motors ($21,600), Bonita Court Garage ($34,000), Atlantic Court Garage ($40,000) and Store n' Bolt ($16,800) — $160,000 in total. Each garage adds one parking spot, which also feeds the Scooter Bros registrations for On the Spot.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — the fee varies with the vehicle's value — and it becomes available for delivery. You need enough empty parking spots, so buying garages (Little Boxes) helps. Ten registrations and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
